name: com.blixtworks.www/tools
title: Blixtworks
description: Vision, web and data tools paid per call in USDC on Base via x402. No account, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: BLIXTWORKS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding a small amount of USDC on Base. Used only to sign per-request payments (well under a cent per call). Use a dedicated low-balance wallet. Without it the free status tool still works.
